title: quercus setulosa subsp. laotica
intro: Quercus setulosa subsp. laotica, commonly known as the Laos oak, is a species of evergreen tree in the beech family Fagaceae. It is a valuable plant in traditional medicine, offering several health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Quercus setulosa subsp. laotica include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, making it useful in the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
